DelBene says the DCCC is prioritizing frontliners, incumbents and races where it has already invested before adding support to newly competitive contests as more resources come in. title: Voters Are Feeling a Deeper Inflation Squeeze: Duppler
title_cn: Voters Are Feeling a Deeper Inflation Squeeze: Duppler
summary: Mattie Duppler, Founder and President of Forward Strategies and spokesperson for The Ledger Project, says a rate hike is more likely than not after the latest CPI report came in modestly higher than expected. Duppler says the data itself matters less politically than how Americans are experiencing higher prices for groceries and gas. Duppler says consumers had a pandemic-era financial cushion when prices rose in 2022, while today they are increasingly using credit cards and savings to cover higher costs. Duppler thinks that financial pressure is what voters will be thinking about as they head to the polls. She speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
